name: medad-cash
description: Medad — Library accounting system (single branch day-one, multi-branch/multi-tenant ready). Strict double-entry, append-only ledger.

scripts.db:setup: npm run pg:start && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api & npm run lint -w apps/web & npm run lint -w packages/shared-types
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api & npm run typecheck -w apps/web & npm run typecheck -w packages/shared-types
